name: New York
standard: WCAG 2.2 AA for state websites (STL §103-d) + WCAG 2.1 AA for web and mobile (ADA Title II)

laws.summary: State agencies must, to the extent practicable, conform new or substantially changed websites to the most current WCAG at level AA by 2027-01-01, or post an annual public progress report.
Extends the WCAG requirement to contractors providing websites under state contracts and directs ITS to issue guidance.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: NYS-P08-005 Accessibility of Information Communication Technology (updated 2024-08-19)

applies_to: All State Entities (Executive Order 117 'State Government' / STL §101 agencies) and third parties, incl. local governments and vendors, using IT resources they administer; contractor-provided websites.

deadlines.what: NYS-P08-005 restates original Title II date for WCAG 2.1 AA (policy predates extension)
STL §103-d: state websites at WCAG 2.2 AA (most current version), else annual public progress report
ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Manual testing before production, before fundamental alterations and biennially
Keep testing reports and an inventory of ICT with compliance status
'Accessibility' link in home-page footer to a page with accessibility contact information
Public progress report (actions, obstacles, efforts, timeline) if not compliant by 2027-01-01, updated annually
mobile: explicit — policy requires web content and mobile applications to meet WCAG 2.1 AA under the DOJ rule.
procurement: Mandatory accessibility clause in all ICT solicitations/contracts (STL, Exec. Law 170-f, P08-005) with acceptance testing; VPAT requested for pre-built software with a UI.
enforcement: ITS policy compliance mandatory for State Entities; public progress reports under STL §103-d; ADA Title II. Contact accessibilityteam@its.ny.gov.
notes: its.ny.gov HTML pages return 403 to automated fetches, so the office URL is the policy PDF. The policy's contract clause mis-cites 'Section 130-d' (should be 103-d). STL §103-d text read via FindLaw summary, not the official NY Senate site (403). 'Most current WCAG' is a moving target — WCAG 2.2 today.

covers_conditionally.when: only when using IT resources the state administers
